title: CBAM Supplier Review Package v1
scope: A preparation package for recipient review. This is not a CBAM declaration, a statutory operator emissions report, or verification of emissions.

values.label: Recipient
values.hint: Name the customer or reviewer receiving this preparation package.

values.label: Prepared by
values.hint: Person responsible for the supplied information.

values.label: Supplier role
values.hint: Keep the supplier and producing operator distinct.

values.label: Production year
values.hint: Definitive-period production year, 2026 or later. This is not a fiscal year.

values.label: Data coverage starts
values.hint: Actual first date covered by these values, within the production year.

values.label: Data coverage ends
values.hint: Actual last date covered, no later than today. Partial-year values remain provisional.

values.label: Producing operator
values.hint: Legal name of the installation operator.

values.label: Operator contact
values.hint: Contact responsible for the emissions information.

values.label: Installation identifier
values.hint: Existing installation or registry identifier, if available; registration is not inferred.

values.label: Installation country
values.hint: Country where the goods are produced.

values.label: Installation name
values.hint: This profile covers one producing installation.

values.label: Installation address
values.hint: Physical location of the producing installation.

values.label: Product name
values.hint: One product represented by this review package.

values.label: Product description
values.rawValue: Synthetic engineering fixture, not a verified emissions declaration.
values.hint: Product specification and production route, if known.

values.label: Reported CN code
values.hint: Exactly eight digits. Syntax checking does not confirm legal scope or classification.

values.label: CN classification review
values.hint: A user-declared review status, not classification verified by this app.

values.label: Process boundary and attribution
values.rawValue: Operator-reported process attribution and total saleable output; see OPS-2026-Q3.
values.hint: Describe the process, production route, outputs, attribution and period underlying the reported values. Reference the monitoring plan or operator report.

values.label: Precursor treatment
values.rawValue: Reported direct value already includes the relevant precursor contribution; see operator paper.
values.hint: Explain which relevant precursors are already included, or why none apply. No precursor amount is added by this app.

values.label: Reported specific-emissions unit
values.hint: Only already reported tCO2e per tonne of goods is supported. No functional-unit conversion is performed.

values.label: Reported direct embedded emissions
values.hint: tCO2e/t goods, including the relevant precursor contribution already attributed by the operator. Zero is valid; blank is unknown.

values.label: Direct data basis
values.hint: A stated basis, not a validated actual-emissions claim.

values.label: Direct source evidence ID
values.hint: ID of a document in the evidence register supporting this reported value.

values.label: Indirect emissions treatment
values.hint: Indirect applicability depends on the goods. Not applicable is distinct from zero or unknown.

values.label: Reported indirect embedded emissions
values.hint: Required when indirect emissions are reported; tCO2e/t goods, including relevant precursors. Never added to direct emissions by this app.

values.label: Indirect data basis
values.hint: Required when indirect emissions are reported.

values.label: Indirect source evidence ID
values.hint: Required when reported; must identify an entry in the evidence register.

values.label: Optional lot net mass
values.hint: Tonnes of the named goods. Used only for indicative, separate mass × reported SEE calculations.

values.label: Verification evidence status
values.hint: The app never verifies emissions or checks accreditation.

values.label: Evidence register
values.rawValue: [{"id":"operator-1","title":"Operator production and emissions working paper","reference":"Operator document OPS-2026-Q3, pages 1-5","version":"2026-10-01 revision 1","period":"2026-01-01 through 2026-09-30","owner":"Example Steel Ltd","disclosure":"shareable"}]
values.hint: JSON array of {id,title,reference,version,period,owner,disclosure}. Disclosure is shareable, restricted or unknown. References are not uploaded or verified by this app.

evidence.title: Operator production and emissions working paper

issues.message: Partial-year / YTD data are provisional. Do not represent these values as a completed annual operator report.
A reviewer must confirm classification and goods-specific CBAM scope. Eight digits alone do not establish applicability.
Data have not been declared verified. Actual values require appropriate accredited verification for regulatory use; this package can be ready for review only.
This is a preparation/review package, not the mandatory operator emissions report, a CBAM declaration, a verification statement or confirmation of legal readiness.

calculations.rule: Lot net mass × the corresponding reported specific embedded emissions. Direct and indirect remain separate. No precursor amount is added.

sources.title: European Commission — CBAM legislation and guidance
European Commission — Guidance No. 2: quick guide for non-EU operators (14 August 2026)
European Commission — Guidance No. 3: methods for embedded emissions (14 August 2026)
